title: I Uploaded One Selfie to ChatGPT and Found Every Photo of Me Online 😳
description:
Hey! 👋

Here's the full guide, every prompt to check where your own photos are showing up online, plus the takedown templates:
👉 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1w1tjiPLNiartVWU8kvOXeRsGp3EksLeT3m6u7OQyb04/edit?usp=sharing

⚠️ Quick heads up before you start:
✅ Turn on work mode in ChatGPT
✅ Keep the whole thing in one chat

That's the part most people skip, and then wonder why it isn't working.

Run it on yourself and tell me what you find. Some of the results genuinely surprise people 👀

📌 Follow for AI moves worth stealing.

— Aashi 💕
